This repository is gitsnap-cli — a lightweight CLI that creates sanitized, AI-ready Git context snapshots.

Key rules for GitHub Copilot / any AI coding assistant:

1. Never weaken secret sanitization.
2. Keep the CLI fast and dependency-light.
3. Prefer CommonJS and simple Node.js patterns.
4. When changing output format, update README.md and consider AGENT.md.
5. Always add tests for new sanitizer patterns.
6. The core promise is: safe, clean, paste-ready Git context for AI tools.

See AGENT.md for the full operating instructions.
